body: apps/desktop full chrome-ext parity 2026-05-25: ThemePopover (mode/font/size/line-height/width sliders + per-slider reset + reset-all), all 11 keyboard shortcuts wired (⌘K search, ⌘B sidebar, \\ toc, F fullscreen, ⇧F reading mode, R raw, ⌘E edit, ⌘S save, [ ] tab cycle on openTabs, X close tab, 1-9 jump to tab, / focus filter, Esc cascading dismiss), input-editable guard for plain-key shortcuts, TOC.tsx (live MutationObserver on .fv-mdx-body h2/h3 rehype-slug ids, smooth scroll), RawView (CodeMirror read-only language+theme aware), Fullscreen + Reading modes (chrome-ext semantics: fullscreen hides everything; reading-mode keeps topbar+tabs), Sidebar filter input (live filter w/ per-project visible count), UI prefs persisted to lib:ui (sidebar/toc/fullscreen/readingMode/raw), content wrapper drives off var(--fv-content-width) so width slider actually re-flows prose. Build + tsc + offscreen render all clean. Still pending: TaskPanel (cross-file aggregator), welcome doc on first launch, JSON theme picker.
